Rae (CS): Bluejay reports heavy 429s right after SDK init during onboarding. Small traces attached.
Priya (Bluejay): We see a burst on first page load across customers — about 30% of initial requests return 429. Using edge-web-sdk v1.2.0, token TTL=15s, mint per tab.
Omar (SE): 15s TTL + mint-per-tab + parallel requests = classic preflight storm. Can you share the init flow?
Priya (Bluejay): simplified: 
```js
const t = await fetch('/mint').then(r=>r.json()).token;
await Promise.all([sdk.call(t,'/init'), sdk.call(t,'/prefs'), sdk.call(t,'/history')]);
```
Priya (Bluejay): we also have an automatic reconnect that re-mints on network flaps.
Luca (SRE): Our policy flags TTL <30s as high-churn and enforces tight per-key caps to protect shared pools — that matches the symptom.
Omar (SE): Immediate client recommendations: 1) avoid Promise.all on coldstart, 2) implement a singleflight for minting, 3) cache token locally until expiry-minus-buffer, 4) add jittered backoff for 429s. Example singleflight: 
```js
let inflight=null;
function mint(){
 if(inflight) return inflight;
 inflight = fetch('/mint').then(r=>r.json()).finally(()=> inflight = null);
 return inflight;
}
```
Priya (Bluejay): security team is worried about longer TTLs. Is there a supported compromise?
Luca (SRE): For onboarding we can permit session tokens ~10 minutes scoped to origin. Alternatively, use a refresh token flow so long-lived credentials are not in the browser. Both reduce mint frequency.
Rae (CS): Would a temporary per-key rate raise help while you push the client change?
Priya (Bluejay): Yes please — a short window would let us roll to 10% of users then full rollout.
Luca (SRE): Temporary bump applied. OpsBot: quota update customer=Bluejay key=web-zz old=80/min new=700/min expires=24h.
OpsBot: change enacted by Luca.
Priya (Bluejay): Deployed singleflight + local cache to canary group — 429s dropped from ~30% to ~2.5% within 12 minutes. Cold-start still shows sporadic 429s when users open multiple tabs very quickly.
Omar (SE): Follow-ups: add client clock check to avoid re-mint when local clock is skewed, instrument token reuse ratio in metrics, and consider small client-side leaky-bucket to smooth bursts.
Rae (CS): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session to review recommended SDK patterns and TTL tradeoffs and note the temporary bump in the customer record.
Priya (Bluejay): Thanks team, huge improvement — will monitor and confirm before the bump expires :rocket:
